speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you had a fever, flank pain, and fatigue after your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. To understand if this is a kidney infection or another complication, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or a strong odor?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with culture. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Compact.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present, Bacterial_Culture Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel's_Solution 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm; Blood_Compact: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to ESBL-producing E. coli (indicated by treatment failure with beta-lactams and recurrence of symptoms).
